name: Ammonia co-firing in coal boilers
applications: lowering CO2 from existing coal units in Japan and Asia
principle: Ammonia is injected through burners into a pulverised-coal boiler to replace part of the coal. JERA and IHI ran 20% ammonia substitution (by heat) at the 1 GW Unit 4 of Hekinan, Japan, from 1 April to 26 June 2024 with NOx no higher than coal alone and SOx down 20%.

process_steps.name: Boiler, steam turbine and flue gas treatment

source.note: JERA, conclusion of fuel ammonia substitution demonstration testing at Hekinan, 26 June 2024
JERA, conclusion of fuel ammonia substitution demonstration testing at Hekinan, 26 June 2024

performance.basis: IHI reports about 20% lower CO2; the JERA notice gives no CO2 figure

limitations: Needs large volumes of low-carbon ammonia to cut CO2 overall
